title: Can I CRUSH Dice Chess? (I can't stop)
summary: More Dice Chess ('I can't stop') on the dice-chess site vs online humans (e.g. ahmetakil): three piece dice per turn, ROLL button, king capture wins with a coin payout.
rules: Each turn roll 3 dice; each die face is a piece type (pawn, knight, bishop, rook, queen, king).
Make up to 3 moves in your turn, one per die, each with a piece of the rolled type; unusable dice are skipped; the same piece may use several dice of its type.
No check/checkmate: kings may be left en prise; capturing the enemy king wins ('YOU WIN King Captured').
Per-move timers; site pays/loses coin stakes (e.g. +2.73).

board.theme_notes: light wood/brown board; 3 red dice tiles with white piece icons; ROLL button; 'YOU WIN King Captured +2.73' popup
